associations.rationale: It gives the character-table entries, one component of the combined classes, rows, quotient, and deleted-representation claim.
It gives the class-size data, one component of the combined claim.
It establishes completeness of the indexed irreducibles, one component of the combined claim.

The type proves the four indexed representations are pairwise nonisomorphic; this supports the four-row classification but does not itself state the displayed classes, characters, quotient, or deleted representation.
The type states that an opaque map qHom is surjective with kernel V4, but its displayed type does not identify the codomain as Z/3 or state the quotient isomorphism.
It establishes irreducibility of the indexed rows, one component of the combined claim.
